## Summary

Fix two bugs causing daemon-dispatched tasks to branch from stale local `master`, resulting in PRs with guaranteed merge conflicts. The daemon never updates its local tracking branches after the initial clone, so new project branches are created from outdated code.

## Requirements

1. **Update local base branch after fetch**: Modify `sync_project_branch()` to force-update the local base branch (e.g., `master`) to match `origin/{base_branch}` after each fetch
2. **Use remote-tracking refs for branch creation**: Modify `create_project_branch()` to branch from `origin/{base_branch}` instead of the local `{base_branch}` ref
3. **Use configured base branch name**: Do not hardcode `"master"` — use `workspace.config.git.base_branch` throughout

## Constraints

- Both fixes are required (defense-in-depth strategy)
- Must work with any base branch name (not just `master`)
- Must not break existing parent project branch resolution logic

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `sync_project_branch()` in `src/git/branch.rs` runs `git branch -f {base_branch} origin/{base_branch}` after fetching
- [ ] `create_project_branch()` in `src/project/lifecycle.rs` uses `origin/{base_branch}` ref when creating new project branches (no parent)
- [ ] Base branch name is read from config, not hardcoded
- [ ] Existing parent project branching logic remains unchanged
- [ ] Daemon-dispatched tasks create project branches from current remote HEAD

## Files to Modify

- `src/git/branch.rs:73-118` — `sync_project_branch()`
- `src/project/lifecycle.rs:353-359` — `create_project_branch()`
- `src/daemon/runtime.rs:566-584` — dispatch flow (may need to pass base branch name)
